title: Withdrawal
author: Gargi Saha
text:
I cannot receive calls promptly
I walk slowly
I fail to comprehend complexities
The cold wars, enmities, misunderstandings
I hesitate to welcome guests
Be a part of the group
I like to stay alone
In darkness
Meditating the joys of yesteryears
And awaiting to sleep silently forever. ..
stanzas: Be a part of the group
And awaiting to sleep silently forever. ..
